$Comment: The first rung of Orrin's Vow, the questline that ends with his own grimoire: the cloth the
cult weaves, brought to him, and the weapons it arms itself with, taken apart.
It opens once First Unmaking is claimed, so it is only ever offered to somebody who owns a
table and has run it. bring_shadoweave is an exact-id hand-in of the fabric scrap every
Outlander drops (TurnInNpcId 'giver', so to Orrin only); unmake_weapons counts weapons the
tables took apart ('Weapon_' on PREFIX, qualified to 'Disenchanting_Table' on PREFIX so both
tiers count, with the shared unmake_weapons TextKey). Both sit on Order 1, so the hunt and the
sitting run side by side and the rung settles once both are in.
Rewards sit in Claim: Enchanting XP. The Chains entry files it as tier 1 of orrins_vow, its
own ladder in the quest book beside the disenchanting chain it runs alongside. Retune the
scrap count to make the hunt longer or shorter.
Name: Shadoweave
